output_list.code:
uint amount = msg.value / buyPrice;               
        _transfer(this, msg.sender, amount);
output_list.reason: The function buy accepts Ether and then transfer token to the sender. The amount of tokens sent is calculated by dividing msg.value by buyPrice. If msg.value is large enough, the calculation will result in an integer overflow, leading to an excessive transfer of tokens. The attacker can exploit this vulnerability to buy an excessive amount of tokens and prevent a fair distribution of the token.
